scheme_name: Financial Assistance in Marriage of Women Workers or Daughters of Workers- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: Applicant must be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana
Applicant must be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board
Monthly salary of the applicant must not exceed ₹25,000
Applicant must have at least three years of regular membership of the Board up to the marriage date
Application must be submitted within six months after the marriage date
Benefits are available for the marriage of up to three daughters or for the self‑marriage of the female worker
Applicant must undertake to disclose any prior benefit availed under the Kanyadaan scheme
benefits_summary: Provides a financial assistance of ₹51,000 to eligible women workers or their daughters for marriage.
